purpose: A node whose current sources balance (1 mA in, 1 mA out) is a valid capacitor island, not a current-source cutset.

oracle.derivation: KCL at a: I1 - I2 - C1 dv(a)/dt = 0 with I1 = I2, so v(a) keeps its operating-point value 0 V (the transient operating point starts the island at 0); v(b) = I2 R1 = 1 V. ngspice 45 .op: a = 0, b = 1.
